0:
rm -rf /home/seanime/.config/Seanime
ln -s /seanime /home/seanime/.config/Seanime
if [ ! -f /seanime/config.toml ]; then
  cat > /seanime/config.toml << 'TOML'
version = '3.9.1'

[cache]
dir = '/cache'
transcodedir = '/cache/transcode'

[database]
name = 'seanime'

[extensions]
dir = '/seanime/extensions'

[logs]
dir = '/seanime/logs'

[anime]
downloaddir = '/media/anime'

[manga]
downloaddir = '/media/manga'
localdir = '/seanime/manga-local'

[offline]
assetdir = '/seanime/offline/assets'
dir = '/seanime/offline'

[server]
host = '0.0.0.0'
offline = false
port = 80
usebinarypath = true
secureMode = 'lax'
accessAllowlist = ['https://*.${SECRET_DOMAIN}']

[torrent]
dir = '/media/downloads/completed/seanime'

[web]
assetdir = '/seanime/assets'
TOML
fi
exec /app/seanime
{{ if eq .Status "resolved" }}👌{{ end }} {{ if eq .Status "firing" }}🚨{{ end }} {{ index .CommonLabels.alertname }}

- job_name: "syno"
  static_configs:
  - targets: ["syno:9100"]
- job_name: "pinewall"
  static_configs:
  - targets: ["pinewall:9100"]
- job_name: "blocky"
  static_configs:
  - targets: ["pinewall:4000"]

prune() {
  echo "[image-cleaner] pruning unused images on $(hostname)"
  /var/lib/rancher/k3s/data/current/bin/crictl \
    -r unix:///run/k3s/containerd/containerd.sock rmi --prune
  echo "[image-cleaner] prune done on $(hostname)"
}
prune
while true; do
  now=$(date +%s)
  next=$(date -d "02:00" +%s)
  [ "$next" -le "$now" ] && next=$((next + 86400))
  sleep $((next - now))
  prune
done

[INPUT]
  name              kubernetes_events
  tag               k8s_events
  kube_url          https://kubernetes.default.svc:443
  kube_ca_file      /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/ca.crt
  kube_token_file   /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/token

[FILTER]
  name    grep
  match   k8s_events
  exclude message already present on machine

[OUTPUT]
  name              http
  match             k8s_events
  host              victoria-logs-server.monitoring.svc.cluster.local
  port              9428
  uri               /insert/jsonline?_stream_fields=type,reason&_msg_field=message&_time_field=date
  format            json_lines
  json_date_format  iso8601
  compress          gzip
